what: The player's model is asked for the target and words by strict OpenRouter json_schema built from the zod schemas that check them (oneOf renamed anyOf), with require_parameters, and zod kept as the backstop. A parse refusal is asked once more by a byte-identical request. Every attempt is a recorded call with its cost and, when refused, the model's whole answer. Score and compare count retries and show what they rescued, on paths that name the request. GLM-5.3-flash and Haiku 5.5 are re-scored on all four sets and a new loss report is committed beside the old one.
stakes: The target call and the words call each send OpenRouter json_schema, strict, built from the very zod schema the answer is then checked against, with require_parameters true, so only endpoints that enforce a requested shape serve them; the zod check stays after it.

An answer refused at parse (no content, not JSON, or not the zod shape) is asked exactly once more by a request byte-identical to the first, a fresh sample at the provider's default since no temperature or seed is set; no other refusal, and no target checked() refuses, is ever asked again.

Every model attempt that came back with a body is a call in run.json with its own reported cost, marked when it was the retry, and carrying the model's whole answer and the refusal's message when it was refused.
Each score entry and score file count the retries asked and rescued, and the compare report shows them per set for both models and lists every goal where a retry was asked, with each refused answer.
Scores and reports made under this request are written to paths that name it, never over the files made before it, and compare refuses a score file made under another request.

GLM-5.3-flash and Haiku 5.5 are each re-scored once per set on calibration, blind-1, blind-2-spent and blind-2 under the new request, and the scores, runs and report are committed together; a provider-failed target halts for a ruling.
DEFAULT_MODEL stays anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5; the prompts are unchanged; the harness still imports nothing from the engine or the server.

criteria.then: on the code before this change the run stops with kind parse at call words and its calls hold only the target. After it, the run ends reached; its calls are, in order, target, words carrying refused with the garbled answer whole (every character the stand-in sent, longer than 80) and the refusal's message, then words with retry true and no refused, each with the stand-in's cost; costUsd is their sum; run.json's words is the valid line; the stand-in received exactly three chat requests and the third body deep-equals the second

outOfScope.summary: Providers do not enforce minLength or trim, so a provider-shaped answer can still be refused by zod; the zod check and the one retry cover it rather than the schema.
